project.name: neuromm26-baseline
project.description: Official baseline code for the NeuroMM-2026 multimodal seizure detection challenge, providing PyTorch data loaders, 30+ EEG encoders, video feature backbones, and late-fusion training pipelines for binary spike detection (Tasks 1–2) and 5-class seizure subtype classification (Task 3).

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Example dotenv template documenting the eight NEUROMM_* environment variables (dataset, output, model, EEG/video feature roots and feature names, runtime env) used to override default paths in trainers and feature loaders.
nodes.languageNotes: Variables are consumed by config loader to override the `paths` block of configs/default.yaml; NEUROMM_EEG_FEATURE_NAME / NEUROMM_VIDEO_FEATURE_NAME let users switch between video backbones (clip, videomae, dinov2, siglip, timesformer) without editing YAML.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level project documentation covering the three NeuroMM-2026 challenge tasks (binary EEG-only, EEG+Video late-fusion, 5-class subtype), setup instructions, HuggingFace gated-data download, and per-task training/eval/aggregation tutorials.

nodes.name: baseline_results.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive results table reporting mean and std across 4 seeds for 30+ EEG encoders and fusion variants on validation and three private test splits, with AUPRC for binary tasks and weighted F1 for 5-class subtype classification.
nodes.languageNotes: Sorted descending by primary metric per table; pairs every legacy EEG backbone with seven video features (clip, videomae-base/large, dinov2-base/large, siglip, timesformer).

nodes.name: default.yaml
nodes.summary: Master baseline configuration defining seed, paths, runtime, model (EEG ResNet18 backbone), dataset (binary EEG-only with shape [26, 2000]), and train/eval hyperparameters that all other configs extend via `default_config`.
nodes.languageNotes: Acts as the inheritance root for all task-specific YAMLs; defines the `eeg_shape: [26, 2000]` (26 channels, 2000 samples per window) baseline.

nodes.name: eval.yaml
nodes.summary: Minimal evaluation override that inherits configs/default.yaml and sets experiment_name to neuromm26_eval; used by scripts/eval.sh as the default eval entry point.

nodes.name: eval_eeg_only.yaml
nodes.summary: Task 1 evaluation override that selects the baseline/eeg model with eeg_only task_type for binary EEG-only spike detection on val/test_task1.

nodes.name: eval_multimodal.yaml
nodes.summary: Task 2 evaluation override selecting the multimodal/eeg_video_fusion model with clip video features and require_video_feature enabled for binary EEG+Video late-fusion eval.

nodes.name: feature_extract.yaml
nodes.summary: Feature extraction mode configuration that inherits defaults and sets mode=feature_extract for the extract_features tool to write video/EEG embeddings to processed/features/.

nodes.name: train.yaml
nodes.summary: Default training entry config that inherits configs/default.yaml and sets experiment_name to neuromm26_train; consumed by scripts/train.sh.

nodes.name: train_eeg_only.yaml
nodes.summary: Task 1 training config selecting the baseline/eeg model with eeg_only task_type; used by scripts/run_baseline_batch.sh as the CONFIG for sweeping all 30+ EEG encoders across 4 seeds.

nodes.name: train_multimodal.yaml
nodes.summary: Task 2 training config selecting the multimodal/eeg_video_fusion model and enabling clip video feature loading for binary EEG+Video late-fusion training.

nodes.name: data_format.md
nodes.summary: Specification of the release-safe dataset layout, manifest column schema (sample_id, split, label, label_type, raw_video_relpath, subject_id, eeg_source_relpath), and runtime path resolution rules for EEG and video features.

nodes.name: evaluation.md
nodes.summary: Placeholder evaluation documentation stub describing where to put metrics, evaluation protocol, and submission generation details (currently unfilled).

nodes.name: project_structure.md
nodes.summary: Documents the canonical neuromm26_datasets/ directory layout (raw, processed/features/eeg, processed/features/video/{feature_name}, annotations, splits) and the loader contract for switching video backbones.

nodes.name: training.md
nodes.summary: Placeholder training documentation stub for training commands, configs, and expected outputs (currently unfilled).

nodes.name: environment.yml
nodes.summary: Conda environment specification defining the neuromm26-baseline env with Python>=3.10, pip, numpy>=1.26, and pyyaml>=6.0 from conda-forge (PyTorch installed separately via pip).

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Top-level package init that re-exports __version__ from version.py as the public neuromm26_baseline.__version__ attribute.

nodes.name: version.py
nodes.summary: Single-source-of-truth version constant defining __version__ = '0.1.0' for the neuromm26-baseline package.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Dataset directory readme instructing users to download train+val features from the gated HuggingFace dataset and extract them into the expected processed/features/{eeg,video} layout (25,426 EEG samples).

nodes.name: neuromm2026_train_val_patient_split
nodes.summary: Patient-split train/val manifest with 25,426 rows and seven columns (sample_id, split, label, label_type, raw_video_relpath, subject_id, eeg_source_relpath) used by all dataset loaders to enumerate samples and resolve EEG and video feature paths at runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: label_type encodes 5-class subtype for Task 3 (positives only); subject_id supports patient-level splitting to prevent leakage between train and val.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pip dependency manifest pinning numpy>=1.26, PyYAML>=6.0, tqdm>=4.66, torch>=2.2, and torchvision>=0.17 — the minimum runtime stack for training and evaluating the baselines.

nodes.name: eval.sh
nodes.summary: Two-line bash wrapper that invokes `python -m neuromm26_baseline.tools.eval --config configs/eval.yaml` and forwards extra CLI args.

nodes.name: extract_features.sh
nodes.summary: Two-line bash wrapper that invokes `python -m neuromm26_baseline.tools.extract_features --config configs/feature_extract.yaml` and forwards extra CLI args.

nodes.name: prepare_dataset.sh
nodes.summary: Bash wrapper that runs `python -m neuromm26_baseline.tools.prepare_dataset` against neuromm26_datasets with raw/eeg_videos as the raw-subdir and --copy-eeg flag to materialize public EEG .npy windows.

nodes.name: run_baseline_batch.sh
nodes.summary: Batch training driver that sweeps a list of EEG models across 4 seeds in parallel on 4 GPUs (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES per process), with per-run log files, fail tracking, and a final aggregate summary suggesting `scripts/aggregate_results.py`.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bash arrays to fan out 4 seeds × N models concurrently per model row, waits on PIDs, captures per-seed exit codes, and writes timestamped logs to neuromm26_results/logs/batch_${TIMESTAMP}/.

nodes.name: train.sh
nodes.summary: Two-line bash wrapper that invokes `python -m neuromm26_baseline.tools.train --config configs/train.yaml` and forwards extra CLI args.

nodes.name: setup.py
nodes.summary: Minimal setuptools install script declaring the neuromm26-baseline package (v0.1.0) with find_packages() and include_package_data; consumed by `pip install -e .`.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Datasets package barrel that re-exports the three primary Dataset classes (NeuroMMDataset, EEGFeatureDataset, NeuroMMMultimodalFeatureDataset) for the seizure-detection baseline.

nodes.name: base_dataset.py
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract BaseDataset interface (subclassing torch.utils.data.Dataset) that establishes the __len__/__getitem__ contract for all NeuroMM Datasets.

nodes.name: BaseDataset
nodes.summary: Abstract Dataset base class declaring the canonical __len__ and __getitem__ methods that all NeuroMM Datasets must implement.

nodes.name: collate_fn.py
nodes.summary: Defines neuromm_collate, a custom DataLoader collate function that stacks Tensor batch fields and forwards non-Tensor metadata as Python lists.

nodes.name: neuromm_collate
nodes.summary: Collate function for NeuroMM batches: torch.stack on tensor-valued keys, list-aggregate on the rest, robust to mixed-type sample dicts.

nodes.name: eeg_feature_dataset.py
nodes.summary: Implements EEGFeatureDataset, a feature-mode binary-classification Dataset that loads pre-computed EEG .npy waves from a manifest CSV, with per-sample normalization and pad/crop to fixed length.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses tqdm-driven optional caching and per-channel z-score normalization with handling of constant-channel zero-variance edge cases.

nodes.name: EEGFeatureDataset
nodes.summary: EEG-only Dataset: parses manifest+split CSVs, optionally caches loaded waves, normalizes channels, and pads or crops to a fixed sequence length before returning a torch.Tensor and binary label.

nodes.name: multimodal_feature_dataset.py
nodes.summary: Implements NeuroMMMultimodalFeatureDataset, a binary-classification Dataset wrapping EEGFeatureDataset and additionally loading per-sample pre-computed video feature .npy tensors.

nodes.name: NeuroMMMultimodalFeatureDataset
nodes.summary: Multimodal binary Dataset: composes an inner EEGFeatureDataset and pairs each EEG sample with a precomputed video feature tensor loaded by record id.

nodes.name: neuromm_dataset.py
nodes.summary: Implements NeuroMMDataset, the primary raw-mode binary-classification Dataset that resolves manifest rows to EEG and (optional) video feature paths and loads tensors on demand.

nodes.name: NeuroMMDataset
nodes.summary: Raw-mode multimodal seizure Dataset that reads a CSV manifest and resolves per-sample EEG/video file paths under configurable root directories, returning np.load tensors plus binary labels.

nodes.name: sampler.py
nodes.summary: Stub module exposing a build_sampler factory placeholder for future custom Sampler construction (currently returns no sampler).

nodes.name: task3_datasets.py
nodes.summary: Task3 5-class seizure-type Datasets: filters manifest rows to positives only and remaps label_type 1..5 to class indices 0..4 for CrossEntropyLoss; ships EEG-only, multimodal, and video-only variants.
nodes.languageNotes: Three Datasets share filtering helpers (_is_positive_row, _class_index, _load_filtered) so the 5-class label space stays consistent across modalities.

nodes.name: _load_filtered
nodes.summary: Reads a manifest CSV, restricts to a given split, then keeps only positive (seizure) rows; raises ValueError if the split has zero positives.

nodes.name: Task3EEGFeatureDataset
nodes.summary: Task3 EEG-only multi-class Dataset reusing EEGFeatureDataset's normalization and pad/crop logic, but yielding integer class indices 0..4 for the 5-class seizure-type head.

nodes.name: Task3MultimodalFeatureDataset
nodes.summary: Task3 multimodal Dataset pairing a Task3EEGFeatureDataset with precomputed per-sample video features for the 5-class seizure-type task.

nodes.name: Task3VideoFeatureDataset
nodes.summary: Video-only Task3 Dataset that mean- or max-pools precomputed video features per sample to feed a lightweight video MLP head on the 5-class problem.

nodes.name: transforms.py
nodes.summary: Stub module exposing a build_transforms factory placeholder for future train/val augmentation pipelines.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty losses package marker to allow `from neuromm26_baseline.losses import ...` imports.

nodes.name: classification_loss.py
nodes.summary: Stub exposing a classification_loss(predictions, targets) function placeholder for the seizure classification head.

nodes.name: focal_loss.py
nodes.summary: Stub exposing a focal_loss(predictions, targets) function placeholder used to address class imbalance in seizure detection.

nodes.name: localization_loss.py
nodes.summary: Stub exposing a localization_loss(predictions, targets) function placeholder for seizure-onset localization regression.

nodes.name: loss_builder.py
nodes.summary: Stub exposing a build_loss(name) factory placeholder intended to dispatch by name to focal/classification/localization losses.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty utils package marker to allow `from neuromm26_baseline.utils import ...` imports.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Hierarchical YAML config loader with dotenv support, deep-merge of `defaults:` chains, environment-variable overrides for dataset paths, and dotted-key CLI override parsing.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements its own minimal dotenv parser and recursive YAML inheritance (`defaults:` key) without external runtime dependencies beyond PyYAML.

nodes.name: load_config
nodes.summary: Top-level config entry point: loads .env, recursively resolves YAML defaults, then layers environment-variable overrides for dataset path keys.

nodes.name: _resolve_config
nodes.summary: Recursively reads a YAML file, follows the optional `defaults:` chain to a parent config, and deep-merges the chain bottom-up.

nodes.name: _set_nested_value
nodes.summary: Writes a value into a nested dict using a dotted key path, creating intermediate dicts and rejecting attempts to overwrite leaf scalars.

nodes.name: parse_override_strings
nodes.summary: Parses a list of `key=value` CLI override strings into a flat dict, with values yaml.safe_load-decoded for typed parsing.

nodes.name: io.py
nodes.summary: Tiny IO helper module that exposes ensure_dir to mkdir-p a path and return its Path object.

nodes.name: logger.py
nodes.summary: Logger factory that returns a configured Python logger with a stream handler and an optional file handler under a parent-mkdir'd path.

nodes.name: get_logger
nodes.summary: Constructs a named logger with a consistent timestamped formatter, a stdout StreamHandler, and (optional) FileHandler — idempotent across calls.

nodes.name: metrics.py
nodes.summary: Binary-classification metrics module: TP/TN/FP/FN counts, precision/recall/F1, balanced accuracy, AUPRC computed via numpy interpolation, plus formatting helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements AUPRC from scratch with monotone precision interpolation over sorted scores rather than relying on scikit-learn.

nodes.name: _compute_auprc
nodes.summary: Computes Area Under Precision-Recall Curve from prediction probabilities and binary targets using sorted-score cumulative sums and monotone precision interpolation.

nodes.name: compute_binary_classification_metrics
nodes.summary: End-to-end binary metric pipeline: sigmoid logits, threshold at 0.5, compute confusion-matrix counts, P/R/F1, balanced accuracy, AUPRC, and prevalence — returns an ordered dict.

nodes.name: order_metric_dict
nodes.summary: Reorders a metrics dict to a canonical display order (AUPRC first, then F1, accuracy, etc.), preserving any extra keys.

nodes.name: format_metric_summary
nodes.summary: Renders a metrics dict as a single space-separated `key=value` summary line for log messages.

nodes.name: multiclass_metrics.py
nodes.summary: Task3 5-class metrics: per-class precision/recall/F1, macro and support-weighted F1 (the primary selection metric), accuracy, and a stable display ordering.

nodes.name: compute_multiclass_metrics
nodes.summary: Computes accuracy, per-class P/R/F1/support, macro-averaged P/R/F1, and support-weighted F1 from raw multi-class logits and integer labels.

nodes.name: order_multiclass_metrics
nodes.summary: Reorders a multi-class metrics dict to a canonical display order led by weighted_f1 (the primary selection metric), then macro_f1 and accuracy.

nodes.name: format_multiclass_summary
nodes.summary: Renders a multi-class metrics dict as a single space-separated `key=value` line for log output.

nodes.name: seed.py
nodes.summary: Reproducibility helpers: set_seed for python/numpy/torch/cuda RNGs (with optional deterministic mode), seed_worker for DataLoader workers, and a torch.Generator factory.
nodes.languageNotes: Sets PYTHONHASHSEED, configures torch.use_deterministic_algorithms, and toggles cudnn.deterministic/benchmark when feature-detected.

nodes.name: set_seed
nodes.summary: Seeds python.random, numpy, torch CPU and CUDA RNGs and optionally enables fully deterministic torch/cudnn execution for reproducible runs.

nodes.name: seed_worker
nodes.summary: DataLoader worker_init_fn that derives a deterministic per-worker seed from torch.initial_seed() and applies it to numpy and python random.

nodes.name: visualization.py
nodes.summary: Stub exposing a render_summary(data) placeholder for future training/eval visualization output.

nodes.name: aggregate_results.py
nodes.summary: CLI aggregator that scans a metrics directory for `*_train_summary.json` files, groups by (model, learning_rate), computes mean and std across seeds, and prints/saves a binary-task results table.

nodes.name: discover_summaries
nodes.summary: Walks a metrics directory glob for *_train_summary.json files and groups loaded entries by the (model_name, learning_rate) tuple.

nodes.name: aggregate
nodes.summary: For each (model, lr) group, computes mean and std of each binary metric across seeds and emits a per-row record for table/CSV output.

nodes.name: print_table
nodes.summary: Pretty-prints aggregated rows as a fixed-width text table sorted by AUPRC, with columns auto-sized to the widest entry per metric.

nodes.name: save_csv
nodes.summary: Persists aggregated rows to a CSV file (creating parent directories), using the metric set from the first row to determine column order.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point: parses --metrics-dir/--seeds/--output args, calls discover_summaries→aggregate→print_table→save_csv, exiting cleanly when no summaries are found.

nodes.name: aggregate_task3_results.py
nodes.summary: CLI aggregator for Task3 (5-class) runs: scans summary JSONs, separates EEG-only and multimodal task variants, computes mean/std across seeds, and prints/saves results tables.

nodes.name: discover
nodes.summary: Loads Task3 *_train_summary.json files filtered by task kind ('eeg' or 'multimodal'), groups by (model, lr), and extracts the multi-class metrics dict for each run.

nodes.name: aggregate
nodes.summary: Computes per-(model, lr) mean and std of each Task3 multi-class metric across seeds, returning rows for downstream printing/saving.

nodes.name: print_table
nodes.summary: Prints a fixed-width Task3 results table sorted by weighted_f1 (the primary selection metric for the 5-class problem), with a title heading per task kind.

nodes.name: save_csv
nodes.summary: Writes Task3 aggregated rows to a CSV file, sorted by weighted_f1 descending, with parent directories created on demand.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for Task3 aggregation: runs the discover→aggregate→print_table→save_csv pipeline once for EEG-only and once for multimodal task kinds.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Top-level model package barrel that re-exports EEGBaselineModel, EEGVideoFusionModel, the legacy EEG registry, and a model-name normalization helper used by training/eval CLIs.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds MODEL_NAME_ALIASES and SUPPORTED_MODEL_NAMES dynamically from the legacy registry to keep CLI flags decoupled from implementation paths.

nodes.name: normalize_model_name
nodes.summary: Maps short CLI-friendly model aliases (e.g. baseline_resnet18) to canonical namespaced names (e.g. baseline/resnet18) using MODEL_NAME_ALIASES.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Backbone package barrel re-exporting EEGResNetEncoder and VideoFeatureProjector for use by multimodal fusion models.

nodes.name: ecg_encoder.py
nodes.summary: Placeholder ECG encoder that passes inputs through unchanged; reserved for future ECG modality integration.

nodes.name: ECGEncoder
nodes.summary: Identity-pass ECG encoder placeholder; not an nn.Module and not currently wired into any baseline model.

nodes.name: eeg_encoder.py
nodes.summary: Placeholder generic EEG encoder; the production EEG backbone is EEGResNetEncoder in eeg_resnet.py.

nodes.name: EEGEncoder
nodes.summary: Identity-pass EEG encoder placeholder superseded by EEGResNetEncoder.

nodes.name: eeg_resnet.py
nodes.summary: Production EEG backbone wrapping torchvision ResNet18/50: collapses RGB conv1 weights into a 1-channel kernel, applies optional temporal average pooling, and returns 512/2048-dim features.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-channel adaptation strategy averages the pretrained RGB conv1 weights along the channel axis so ImageNet weights remain useful for grayscale-like EEG spectrograms.

nodes.name: EEGResNetEncoder
nodes.summary: nn.Module that adapts torchvision resnet18/resnet50 to single-channel EEG inputs, exposes feature_dim, and wraps the global-pooled features in optional temporal pooling and dropout.

nodes.name: emg_encoder.py
nodes.summary: Placeholder EMG encoder reserved for future biosignal modality support.

nodes.name: EMGEncoder
nodes.summary: Identity-pass EMG encoder placeholder; not an nn.Module and not yet integrated.

nodes.name: video_encoder.py
nodes.summary: Placeholder video encoder; baselines currently consume precomputed CLIP/DINOv2/VideoMAE/SigLIP/TimeSformer features via VideoFeatureProjector instead.

nodes.name: VideoEncoder
nodes.summary: Identity-pass video encoder placeholder; superseded by VideoFeatureProjector for projecting precomputed features.

nodes.name: video_projector.py
nodes.summary: Lightweight MLP that flattens precomputed video features (e.g. CLIP/DINOv2/VideoMAE) and projects them to a fixed embedding via a LazyLinear+ReLU+Dropout block.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses nn.LazyLinear so the input dimension is inferred at first forward pass, keeping the projector agnostic to the upstream feature extractor (CLIP, DINOv2, VideoMAE, SigLIP, TimeSformer).

nodes.name: VideoFeatureProjector
nodes.summary: nn.Module projecting precomputed video features to a fixed-size embedding using Flatten -> LazyLinear -> ReLU -> Dropout.

nodes.name: baseline_model.py
nodes.summary: Top-level baseline model placeholder; concrete baselines live in eeg_baseline.py and multimodal_baseline.py.

nodes.name: BaselineModel
nodes.summary: Identity-pass baseline class placeholder; not used by training pipelines.

nodes.name: eeg_baseline.py
nodes.summary: Single-modal EEG baseline composing EEGResNetEncoder with BinaryClassificationHead for Task1/Task2 binary seizure detection from EEG-only inputs.

nodes.name: EEGBaselineModel
nodes.summary: nn.Module wiring an EEGResNetEncoder feeding a BinaryClassificationHead; expects batch['eeg'] tensors and returns binary logits.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty fusion package marker; individual fusion modules are imported directly by downstream models.

nodes.name: concat_fusion.py
nodes.summary: Simple concatenation fusion module that joins EEG and video feature tensors along the last dim, used by EEGVideoFusionModel.

nodes.name: ConcatFusion
nodes.summary: nn.Module performing torch.cat over the last dimension to fuse EEG and video feature embeddings.

nodes.name: cross_attention_fusion.py
nodes.summary: Placeholder cross-attention fusion entry that returns inputs unchanged; reserved for future query/key/value cross-modal attention implementation.

nodes.name: temporal_fusion.py
nodes.summary: Placeholder temporal fusion entry returning inputs unchanged; reserved for future time-aware multimodal fusion (e.g. transformer over time steps).

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty heads package marker; individual heads are imported directly by downstream models.

nodes.name: classification_head.py
nodes.summary: Defines BinaryClassificationHead, an MLP-or-Linear head producing a single logit; supports both shallow (Dropout+Linear) and deep (Linear+ReLU+Dropout+Linear) variants.

nodes.name: BinaryClassificationHead
nodes.summary: nn.Module head emitting a single seizure-vs-background logit; switches between shallow and 2-layer MLP based on whether hidden_dim is provided.

nodes.name: localization_head.py
nodes.summary: Placeholder localization head; reserved for future Task2 onset/offset regression or per-frame seizure localization.

nodes.name: LocalizationHead
nodes.summary: Identity-pass localization head placeholder, not wired into any model yet.

nodes.name: multiclass_late_fusion.py
nodes.summary: Task3 5-class late-fusion baseline: a legacy EEG model (rebuilt with num_classes=5) and a video MLP each emit per-class logits, combined by a Linear(10, 5) initialized to per-class mean-of-experts.
nodes.languageNotes: Combiner weight is hand-initialized to a block-diagonal per-class average so training starts from logit-mean ensembling, then learns adaptive weights.

nodes.name: EEGVideoLateFusion5Class
nodes.summary: nn.Module Task3 5-class late-fusion: builds a legacy EEG model with num_classes=5, mean-pools precomputed video features, runs a 2-layer video MLP, and learns a (2C, C) combiner initialized to mean-of-experts.

nodes.name: multimodal_baseline.py
nodes.summary: Early-fusion multimodal baseline composing EEGResNetEncoder, VideoFeatureProjector, ConcatFusion, and BinaryClassificationHead for joint EEG+video binary seizure detection.

nodes.name: EEGVideoFusionModel
nodes.summary: nn.Module performing concat-based early fusion of EEG (ResNet) and video (projected) features, sized so the head input is feature_dim+video_embedding_dim.

nodes.name: multimodal_late_fusion.py
nodes.summary: Task1/Task2 binary late-fusion baseline: a full legacy EEG model emits one logit, a video MLP emits another, and a Linear(2, 1) combiner initialized to (0.5, 0.5) learns adaptive weighting.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a get_branch_logits() diagnostic hook returning (eeg_logit, video_logit) per sample for branch attribution analysis.

nodes.name: EEGVideoLateFusion
nodes.summary: nn.Module binary late-fusion: legacy EEG model -> 1 logit, video MLP -> 1 logit, learnable Linear(2, 1) combiner initialized to mean-of-experts; exposes get_branch_logits for diagnostics.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for the migrated legacy EEG model family; re-exports the registry, adapter class, and builder helpers so release builds can import them without depending on old_baseline.

nodes.name: actnet.py
nodes.summary: Implements ACTNet, a per-window Conformer EEG encoder combining a separable temporal SE-augmented front end, sliding-window transformer blocks, and a window-fusion transformer used by the actnet_s/actnet_m baselines for Task 1/2.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses two-stage attention (per-window + cross-window fusion) with PreNorm + ConvModule conformer blocks, similar to the speech Conformer recipe adapted to EEG.

nodes.name: cbramod.py
nodes.summary: Wrapper module that adapts the vendored CBraMod backbone (criss-cross spatial+temporal Transformer) to the project's [B, 26, 2000] input contract, optionally loading pretrained weights from a checkpoint path.
nodes.languageNotes: Reshapes [B, C, T] into [B, C, seq_len, patch_size] patches, runs the criss-cross encoder, then flattens to a linear classifier.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the vendored CBraMod source tree.

nodes.name: cbramod.py
nodes.summary: Vendored CBraMod backbone: combines a multi-stage convolutional patch projection with FFT-based spectral features and a stack of criss-cross Transformer encoder layers operating on [B, C, S, D] tensors.
nodes.languageNotes: Adds positional encoding via a depthwise 19x7 Conv2d over the (channel, time) grid - tailored to the canonical 10-20 EEG montage.

nodes.name: criss_cross_transformer.py
nodes.summary: Vendored criss-cross Transformer encoder layer that splits the embedding dimension in half and applies independent spatial- and temporal-axis MultiheadAttention before concatenating outputs.
nodes.languageNotes: Operates on 4D [B, C, S, D] tensors with reshape-based factorized attention, replacing torch.nn.TransformerEncoderLayer.

nodes.name: cnn_eeg.py
nodes.summary: ImageNet-style 2D CNN backbone wrapper (ConvNeXt, EfficientNetV2, MobileNetV3, DenseNet) adapted to single-channel EEG spectrogram-like inputs; powers convnext_*/efficientnet_v2_s/mobilenet_v3_large/densenet121 baselines.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses timm to fetch backbones, adapts the DenseNet stem for small EEG inputs, and converts the first conv to single-channel by averaging RGB weights.

nodes.name: densenet_vit_eeg.py
nodes.summary: Hybrid encoder combining a DenseNet front end producing an EEG image feature map with a ViT backbone that performs global attention; backs the densenet_vit_eeg baseline.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses residual fusion of DenseNet and ViT features after reshaping EEG into a square pseudo-image.

nodes.name: eeg_dino.py
nodes.summary: EEG-DINO encoder using DINO-pretrained ViT-style transformer blocks with EEG-specific patch embedding (time-domain CNN + spectral FFT + channel positional encoding); supports S/M/L variants loaded from external checkpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Restricts input to the first 19 channels (10-20 montage) to match DINO pretraining; freeze_ratio supports partial fine-tuning.

nodes.name: eegnet.py
nodes.summary: Modernized EEGNet variant with separable temporal blocks, optional Squeeze-Excitation, configurable pooling sequence, and a multi-layer MLP head; powers eegnet/eegnet_m/eegnet_xl baselines.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses depthwise + separable convs with configurable temporal pooling and SE bottlenecks - a richer EEGNet generalization than the canonical Lawhern et al. design.

nodes.name: labram.py
nodes.summary: Wrapper around the LaBraM (Large Brain Model) BEiT-v2 style encoder with temporal convolution patch embedding, channel/time positional encoding, and optional pretrained checkpoint loading; backs labram_base and labram_large baselines.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses einops rearrange for flexible patching and matches the original LaBraM weight key layout when loading checkpoints.

nodes.name: lmda.py
nodes.summary: LMDA-Net encoder featuring an EEG depth attention module and stacked depthwise temporal convolutions with adaptive pooling; backs the lmda_eeg baseline.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses runtime shape inference (_infer_temporal_out_shape, _infer_flat_dim) so the MLP head adapts to varying input samples.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Central registry for legacy EEG-only baselines, exposing MODEL_SPECS (33 named variants), a LegacyEEGModelAdapter that bridges tensor-only Nets to the dict batch API, and the build_legacy_eeg_model factory used by Task 1/2 trainers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses importlib.import_module to lazily resolve each module's Net class, keeping the registry decoupled from heavy backbone imports until requested.

nodes.name: registry_task3.py
nodes.summary: Task 3 helper that re-uses MODEL_SPECS but overrides num_classes to build legacy EEG models with a 5-class head for the multi-class seizure-type setting.

nodes.name: resnet_eeg.py
nodes.summary: ResNet-18/50 wrapper adapted to single-channel EEG inputs with first-conv weight averaging across the original RGB channels; backs the resnet18_eeg and resnet50_eeg baselines.

nodes.name: rnn_eeg_big.py
nodes.summary: Heavy CNN-LSTM/GRU encoder combining a temporal conv front, EEG spatial front, residual bidirectional RNN blocks, and multi-head attention pooling; powers lstm_big_eeg, lstm_huge_eeg, and gru_big_eeg baselines.
nodes.languageNotes: Bidirectional residual RNN with attention pooling - effectively a beefier CNN-RNN hybrid for long EEG sequences.

nodes.name: tcnet.py
nodes.summary: TCNet encoder combining an EEGNet-style front end with stacked dilated causal Temporal Convolutional Network blocks and attention pooling; backs the tcnet_eeg and tcnet_eeg_l baselines.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses weight_norm + exponential dilations and a dedicated CausalConv1d to enforce TCN causality on the temporal axis.

nodes.name: vit_eeg.py
nodes.summary: Pure-ViT EEG encoder that converts raw EEG into a normalized image-like tensor and feeds it through a timm ViT (small/base/large at 224 or 384); backs the vit_*_eeg baselines.
nodes.languageNotes: _avg_to_1ch_conv3 converts a 3-channel patch_embed conv into a single-channel conv by averaging - standard recipe for adapting ImageNet ViTs to grayscale signals.

nodes.name: vit_hybrid_eeg.py
nodes.summary: ResNet-ViT hybrid encoder where a ResNet front end produces feature maps that are then patchified and fed into a ViT, with optional residual fusion; backs the vit_hybrid_eeg baseline.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: Top-level ACTNet encoder wiring an EEGFront feature extractor, sliding-window segmentation, per-window Conformer transformer, and window-fusion transformer into a classifier head.

nodes.name: EEGFront
nodes.summary: EEGNet-style front end for ACTNet using stacked separable temporal residual blocks with optional SE attention to project [B, 1, C, T] into a feature map for the conformer stage.

nodes.name: PerWindowConformer
nodes.summary: Stack of conformer-style blocks (PreNorm self-attention + ConvModule1d + feed-forward) operating on each EEG window independently before fusion.

nodes.name: WindowFusion
nodes.summary: Cross-window transformer that aggregates per-window features into a single sequence representation using a CLS token or attention pooling.

nodes.name: ConvModule1d
nodes.summary: Conformer-style 1D conv module with pointwise + depthwise + GLU + layernorm; provides the local-feature pathway inside each PerWindowConformer block.

nodes.name: SepTemporalResBlock2d
nodes.summary: Residual block applying a separable temporal 2D convolution with optional SE attention used by EEGFront.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: CBraMod adapter Net that reshapes [B, 26, 2000] EEG into channel x patch x time tensors, loads optional pretrained weights, runs the CBraMod backbone, and flattens features into a classifier head.

nodes.name: CBraMod
nodes.summary: Vendored CBraMod backbone: PatchEmbedding + criss-cross TransformerEncoder stack + linear projection head, expecting [B, C, S, P] inputs.

nodes.name: PatchEmbedding
nodes.summary: Combines a multi-layer 2D conv patch projector, FFT-based spectral linear projector, and depthwise 19x7 positional encoder into a single embedding for CBraMod.

nodes.name: TransformerEncoderLayer
nodes.summary: Criss-cross Transformer encoder layer that splits the d_model in half and applies separate spatial-axis and temporal-axis MultiheadAttention modules before concatenating, using a Pre-LN structure.

nodes.name: TransformerEncoder
nodes.summary: Stack of TransformerEncoderLayer modules implementing the criss-cross Transformer used by CBraMod.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: Generic timm-based 2D CNN EEG encoder (ConvNeXt/EfficientNetV2/MobileNetV3/DenseNet) with single-channel adaptation, temporal pooling, and a dropout-MLP classifier head.

nodes.name: _load_backbone
nodes.summary: Loads a timm backbone by name with pretrained weights, removes its head, and adapts the stem and first conv to single-channel EEG inputs.

nodes.name: _replace_first_conv_to_1ch
nodes.summary: Walks through a torchvision/timm backbone to find the first Conv2d and replace it with a single-channel conv whose weights are averaged across the original RGB channels.

nodes.name: _adapt_densenet_stem_for_small_input
nodes.summary: Replaces the DenseNet 7x7 stride-2 stem with a smaller 3x3 stride-1 stem so EEG-size pseudo-images are not over-downsampled.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: DenseNet-ViT hybrid EEG encoder that converts EEG into a square image, runs a DenseNet front end, then feeds the feature map into a ViT backbone with residual fusion before the classifier.

nodes.name: DenseNetFrontend
nodes.summary: DenseNet feature extractor that takes single-channel EEG images and returns intermediate dense feature maps for downstream ViT consumption.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: EEG-DINO Net wrapping a PatchEmbedding + EEGEncoder ViT backbone, with checkpoint loading, optional partial freezing via freeze_ratio, and a dropout-MLP classifier.

nodes.name: EEGEncoder
nodes.summary: Stack of ViT-style _Block transformers consuming the EEG-DINO patch embeddings and producing classification-ready features.

nodes.name: PatchEmbedding
nodes.summary: EEG-specific patch embedding combining time-domain CNN features, FFT-based spectral features, and channel positional encoding for the first 19 channels of the 10-20 montage.

nodes.name: _Attention
nodes.summary: ViT-style multi-head self-attention block used inside each EEG-DINO transformer block.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: Public EEGNet wrapper Net that owns an _EEGNetCore feature extractor and an MLP classification head with configurable hidden width and depth.

nodes.name: _EEGNetCore
nodes.summary: EEGNet core feature extractor: temporal conv -> depthwise spatial conv across channels -> stacked SeparableTemporalBlocks with optional SE and configurable pooling sequence.

nodes.name: SeparableTemporalBlock
nodes.summary: Separable temporal residual block (depthwise 1D conv + pointwise 1D conv + optional SE) used as the repeated building block inside _EEGNetCore.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: LaBraM Net wrapper that builds a NeuralTransformer backbone, optionally loads pretrained checkpoints with key remapping, and attaches a dropout-MLP classifier head.

nodes.name: NeuralTransformer
nodes.summary: BEiT-v2 style Vision Transformer backbone for LaBraM with TemporalConv patch embedding, channel/time positional encoding, and a stack of Block transformer layers.

nodes.name: TemporalConv
nodes.summary: Temporal convolution patch embedding that projects each EEG patch into the transformer embed_dim using stacked Conv2d+GELU layers.

nodes.name: Block
nodes.summary: BEiT-v2 transformer block (LayerNorm + Attention + DropPath + Mlp) used as the LaBraM backbone building block.

nodes.name: Attention
nodes.summary: Multi-head self-attention with optional QK normalization and relative position bias support, used inside each LaBraM Block.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: LMDA-Net main encoder with stacked depthwise temporal convolutions, channel attention via EEGDepthAttention, average pooling, and a dynamically-sized MLP classifier head.

nodes.name: EEGDepthAttention
nodes.summary: Channel-depth attention module that reweights LMDA-Net feature channels using a small softmax-gated convolution.

nodes.name: LegacyEEGModelAdapter
nodes.summary: Thin nn.Module adapter that takes a tensor-only legacy EEG Net and exposes it under the project's batch-dict forward API by selecting batch['eeg'].

nodes.name: build_legacy_eeg_model
nodes.summary: Public factory that resolves a registered model name to its module + kwargs and instantiates a wrapped LegacyEEGModelAdapter for Task 1/2 binary classification.

nodes.name: is_legacy_eeg_model_name
nodes.summary: Predicate used by trainers to detect whether a requested model name is provided by the legacy registry.

nodes.name: _build_local_model
nodes.summary: Internal helper that uses importlib to lazy-load the requested model module and instantiate its Net class with the registered kwargs, wrapped in LegacyEEGModelAdapter.

nodes.name: build_legacy_eeg_model_with_num_classes
nodes.summary: Task 3 factory that re-uses MODEL_SPECS but overrides num_classes (default 5) before invoking _build_local_model, producing legacy encoders with multi-class heads.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: ResNet-based EEG encoder Net that runs a single-channel-adapted ResNet18/50 backbone over EEG pseudo-images and applies temporal pooling + dropout MLP head.

nodes.name: _load_resnet
nodes.summary: Loads a torchvision ResNet18 or ResNet50 with optional ImageNet pretrained weights and strips the classification head.

nodes.name: _convert_first_conv_to_single_channel
nodes.summary: Replaces the ResNet's first 7x7 RGB conv with a single-channel conv whose weight is the mean of the original 3-channel kernel, preserving pretrained features.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: Heavy CNN-RNN encoder Net combining TemporalConvFront, EEGSpatialFront, stacked ResidualBiRNNBlock layers, and MultiHeadAttnPool readout for the lstm_big/lstm_huge/gru_big baselines.

nodes.name: ResidualBiRNNBlock
nodes.summary: Bidirectional LSTM/GRU block with residual projection and layer normalization, stacked to form the recurrent backbone of rnn_eeg_big.

nodes.name: MultiHeadAttnPool
nodes.summary: Multi-head attention pooling head that converts a sequence of RNN hidden states into a fixed-size embedding via a learned query vector.

nodes.name: EEGSpatialFront
nodes.summary: EEG spatial mixing front end with depthwise+pointwise convolutions across the channel axis to produce per-time spatial embeddings for the RNN stack.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: Public TCNet wrapper Net that exposes the inner TCNet feature extractor through the registry-compatible API for the tcnet_eeg/tcnet_eeg_l baselines.

nodes.name: TCNet
nodes.summary: TCNet encoder body combining an EEGNet-style _EEGFrontend with a stack of dilated TemporalBlock TCN layers and AttnPool1d readout, terminated by a dropout-MLP classifier.

nodes.name: _EEGFrontend
nodes.summary: Lightweight EEGNet-style front end (temporal conv + depthwise spatial conv + separable conv) that produces [B, F2, 1, T'] embeddings for the TCN stack.

nodes.name: TemporalBlock
nodes.summary: Dilated TCN residual block with two CausalConv1d layers, weight normalization, ReLU, and dropout - the canonical Bai et al. TCN building block.

nodes.name: CausalConv1d
nodes.summary: Causal 1D convolution module that pads only on the left so future timesteps cannot leak into earlier outputs - core building block of TemporalBlock.

nodes.name: AttnPool1d
nodes.summary: Single-query attention pooling over the TCN time axis that aggregates [B, C, T] sequences into a fixed-size embedding.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: Pure ViT EEG encoder Net that converts EEG into a normalized image via EEG2Image and runs it through a single-channel-adapted timm ViT (small/base/large at 224 or 384).

nodes.name: EEG2Image
nodes.summary: Adaptor module that z-normalizes raw EEG, reshapes [B, C, T] into a [B, 1, H, W] pseudo-image, and resizes it to the ViT input resolution.

nodes.name: _build_vit_any
nodes.summary: Builds a timm ViT (small/base/large at 224 or 384) with pretrained weights and converts its 3-channel patch_embed conv to single-channel by averaging RGB filters.

nodes.name: Net
nodes.summary: ViT-Hybrid Net combining a ResNetFrontend that produces feature maps with a timm ViT backbone using residual fusion, supporting optional ResNet stem freezing.

nodes.name: ResNetFrontend
nodes.summary: Truncated ResNet feature extractor used as the front end of vit_hybrid_eeg, producing intermediate feature maps that are reshaped to ViT-style patch tokens.

nodes.name: _build_vit_backbone
nodes.summary: Builds a timm ViT backbone for vit_hybrid_eeg that consumes pre-tokenized features from the ResNet front end rather than raw images.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker exposing the per-modality feature extraction CLIs as a Python subpackage.

nodes.name: check_missing.py
nodes.summary: Diagnostic utility that cross-references a sample manifest against extracted CLIP-base video feature .npy files to flag missing/duplicate sample IDs.

nodes.name: check_missing_features
nodes.summary: Compares manifest sample_ids against .npy filenames in the video/clip-base feature dir, reporting missing rows, duplicate IDs, and rows with NaN raw_video_relpath.

nodes.name: extract_all_features.py
nodes.summary: Stub orchestrator placeholder for running every per-modality feature extractor; raises NotImplementedError pending full pipeline wiring.

nodes.name: extract_audio_features.py
nodes.summary: OpenSMILE-based audio feature extractor: demuxes 16 kHz mono WAV via ffmpeg, then runs eGeMAPSv02 (88-D) or ComParE_2016 (6373-D) functionals, saving (D,) float32 .npy per sample.
nodes.languageNotes: Lazy imports opensmile to keep the dependency optional for users only running other modalities.

nodes.name: lazy_import_opensmile
nodes.summary: Defers the opensmile import until first use so that other extractors don't require the heavyweight C++ binding.

nodes.name: feature_set_for
nodes.summary: Maps a registry name (opensmile-egemaps / opensmile-compare) to the corresponding (FeatureSet, expected_dim, label) tuple.

nodes.name: ensure_audio_wav
nodes.summary: Demuxes the audio track of a video file to a mono WAV at the requested sample rate via a subprocess ffmpeg call; returns False if the audio stream is missing.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entrypoint that iterates over a manifest, demuxes audio, runs OpenSMILE functionals, and writes (D,) float32 .npy files plus a summary report.

nodes.name: extract_ecg_features.py
nodes.summary: Stub ECG feature extraction module that raises NotImplementedError; reserved for future ECG-derived feature support.

nodes.name: extract_eeg_features.py
nodes.summary: Stub EEG feature extraction module that raises NotImplementedError; raw EEG handling currently lives in dataset preprocessing rather than this entrypoint.

nodes.name: extract_emg_features.py
nodes.summary: Stub EMG feature extraction module that raises NotImplementedError; placeholder for future EMG modality support.

nodes.name: extract_face_features.py
nodes.summary: OpenFace 2.x wrapper: invokes the FeatureExtraction binary on each video to produce 31-D per-frame facial features (17 AU intensities + 6 head pose + 8 gaze) saved as (T, 31) float32 .npy.

nodes.name: find_binary
nodes.summary: Locates the OpenFace FeatureExtraction binary either via an explicit path or via shutil.which on PATH; raises with install hints when missing.

nodes.name: run_openface
nodes.summary: Invokes OpenFace FeatureExtraction on a single video via subprocess and returns the path to the resulting per-frame CSV.

nodes.name: parse_features
nodes.summary: Parses an OpenFace CSV and selects the AU/head-pose/gaze columns, returning a (T, 31) float32 numpy array.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entrypoint iterating the manifest, running OpenFace on each video, writing per-sample (T, 31) feature .npy files plus a missing/error summary.

nodes.name: extract_video_features.py
nodes.summary: Multi-backbone video feature extractor with a polymorphic registry covering CLIP, VideoMAE, DINOv2, SigLIP, and TimeSformer; uniformly samples frames per video and saves (T, D) or (1, D) feature arrays to disk.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Strategy/Template-Method pattern: BaseVideoExtractor defines the contract and subclasses implement setup_model and extract_features for each HuggingFace backbone. Heavy transformer imports are deferred to setup_model so the lighter CLIP-only path doesn't pay the cost.

nodes.name: BaseVideoExtractor
nodes.summary: Abstract base class defining the (model_path, device) constructor and the setup_model / extract_features contract that every video backbone must implement.

nodes.name: CLIPExtractor
nodes.summary: CLIPModel-based per-frame extractor that returns L2-normalized image features of shape (T, 512) from a HuggingFace CLIP checkpoint.

nodes.name: VideoMAEExtractor
nodes.summary: VideoMAE clip-level extractor that resamples to exactly 16 frames and returns the mean-pooled last_hidden_state of shape (1, hidden_size).

nodes.name: DinoV2Extractor
nodes.summary: Per-frame DINOv2 image encoder using the pooler_output (CLS) with L2-normalization, returning shape (T, D).

nodes.name: SigLIPExtractor
nodes.summary: Per-frame SigLIP image encoder via get_image_features() with L2-normalization, returning shape (T, D).

nodes.name: TimeSformerExtractor
nodes.summary: TimeSformer (k400 finetune) clip-level extractor that resamples to 8 frames and mean-pools last_hidden_state to shape (1, D).

nodes.name: get_extractor
nodes.summary: Factory that maps a feature_name string (clip-base, videomae-large, dinov2-large, siglip-base, timesformer-k400, ...) to the corresponding extractor instance.

nodes.name: extract_frames_uniformly
nodes.summary: Reads a video with OpenCV and uniformly samples num_frames PIL Images for downstream encoders.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entrypoint that selects an extractor via --feature-name, iterates the manifest with tqdm, and writes per-sample (T, D) feature .npy files.

nodes.name: inspect_npy.py
nodes.summary: Tiny CLI helper that prints shape, dtype, and basic statistics of an extracted feature .npy file for ad-hoc inspection.

nodes.name: _task3_runtime.py
nodes.summary: Private shared runtime for the three Task3 multiclass trainers: provides a no-grad evaluation loop, prediction-CSV writer, JSON dumper, and inverse-frequency class weight helper.

nodes.name: evaluate_multiclass
nodes.summary: No-grad evaluation loop that runs a multiclass model over a DataLoader, computes weighted/macro metrics via compute_multiclass_metrics, and returns logits, probabilities, predictions, and labels.

nodes.name: save_predictions_csv
nodes.summary: Writes per-sample multiclass predictions and per-class probabilities to a CSV with sample_id, prediction, prob_0..prob_K-1, label columns.

nodes.name: class_balanced_weights
nodes.summary: Computes inverse-frequency class weights over an integer label list for use as the weight argument to torch CrossEntropyLoss.

nodes.name: eval.py
nodes.summary: CLI entrypoint that loads a checkpoint, runs the binary Evaluator on a dataset split, and writes ordered metrics JSON plus an optional prediction CSV.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Argparse-driven evaluation flow: load YAML config, build dataset/loader/model, restore checkpoint, run Evaluator.evaluate, and persist metrics.json + predictions.csv under output_root.

nodes.name: extract_features.py
nodes.summary: Placeholder CLI that loads a feature_extract YAML and prints it; real extraction lives in the per-modality scripts under feature_extract/.

nodes.name: infer.py
nodes.summary: CLI entrypoint that loads a checkpoint and runs InferenceRunner over a (typically test) split, exporting a submission-ready sample_id,probability CSV.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Argparse flow that builds the dataloader, loads checkpoint weights with weights_only=True, and runs InferenceRunner.run to produce a submission CSV at output_root/submissions/.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: Unified CLI dispatcher that routes 'train' / 'eval' / 'infer' subcommands to the corresponding tool module, forwarding remaining argv unchanged.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Top-level dispatcher that consumes the subcommand argument, then delegates to train_tool.main / eval_tool.main / infer_tool.main with the remaining argv.

nodes.name: prepare_dataset.py
nodes.summary: Dataset preparation CLI that normalizes raw CSV annotations, infers subject IDs from video paths, copies public EEG files into a release-safe layout, and writes per-split CSVs plus a JSON summary.

nodes.name: load_records
nodes.summary: Reads the raw annotation CSV and produces normalized record dicts with sample_id, split, label, raw_video_relpath, subject_id, and eeg_source_relpath fields.

nodes.name: copy_public_eeg
nodes.summary: Copies each record's source EEG file into the dataset_root tree at its release-safe location.

nodes.name: collect_unmatched_videos
nodes.summary: Walks the dataset video tree to surface video files that were not referenced by any record in the annotation CSV.

nodes.name: write_summary
nodes.summary: Writes a JSON summary capturing per-split counts, label distribution, and unmatched-video listings for the prepared dataset release.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Argparse driver that loads the raw CSV, normalizes records, copies EEG files, writes per-split manifest CSVs, and emits the dataset summary JSON.

nodes.name: runtime.py
nodes.summary: Shared runtime helpers consumed by train/eval/infer entrypoints: device resolution, manifest/split path resolution, dataset/dataloader/model/criterion factories, and JSON/CSV result writers.
nodes.languageNotes: build_model centralizes the legacy/baseline/multimodal naming dispatch and is the single hub through which all binary-task models are instantiated.

nodes.name: build_dataset
nodes.summary: Builds either an EEGFeatureDataset or a NeuroMMMultimodalFeatureDataset for a given split based on config['model']['task_type'] (eeg_only or eeg_video_fusion).

nodes.name: build_dataloader
nodes.summary: Wraps a dataset in a torch DataLoader using the project's neuromm_collate, a seeded worker_init_fn, and a deterministic torch.Generator for reproducibility.

nodes.name: build_model
nodes.summary: Central model factory dispatching on normalized model name to legacy EEG models, EEGBaselineModel (resnet18/50), or EEGVideoFusionModel.

nodes.name: build_criterion
nodes.summary: Returns a BCEWithLogitsLoss; if no positive_class_weight is configured, derives one as neg/pos count to mitigate class imbalance.

nodes.name: save_prediction_csv
nodes.summary: Writes per-sample sigmoid probabilities (and optional ground-truth labels) to a CSV ready for aggregation or submission.

nodes.name: train.py

nodes.name: _collect_overrides
nodes.summary: Translates argparse Namespace flags (--model-name, --seed, --learning-rate, --set, ...) into a dotted-key override dict applied to the YAML config.

nodes.name: _build_experiment_name
nodes.summary: Composes a deterministic experiment_name from the base name, sanitized model name, seed, and learning rate so that per-seed/per-model runs sort cleanly under outputs/.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: End-to-end training CLI: applies CLI overrides, seeds, builds dataloaders/model/criterion/optimizer, instantiates Trainer, runs fit, and persists resolved config + train_summary.json with best_metric and best_checkpoint_path.

nodes.name: train_eeg_video_fusion.py

nodes.name: detect_video_feature_dim

nodes.name: build_loaders
nodes.summary: Builds train/val (and optional test) NeuroMMMultimodalFeatureDataset DataLoaders using neuromm_collate and a seeded torch.Generator for reproducibility.

nodes.name: train_task3_eeg.py

nodes.name: main

nodes.name: train_task3_fusion.py

nodes.name: detect_video_feature_dim
nodes.summary: Loads any .npy under {video_feature_root}/{video_feature_name} and returns its trailing dim to size the multiclass fusion classifier head.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Driver for Task3 fusion training: argparse, dataset/loader build, fusion model construction, CE-with-optional-class-weights training loop, weighted_f1 selection, and final test_task3 evaluation+CSV.

nodes.name: MLP5

nodes.name: main

nodes.name: train_video_feature_mlp.py

nodes.name: VideoFeatureDataset

nodes.name: MLPHead

nodes.summary: No-grad evaluation helper that runs the MLPHead over a loader and returns (logits, labels, sample_ids) for downstream metric computation.

nodes.name: main

layers.description: First-party PyTorch encoder backbones for individual modalities (EEG CNN/ResNet, ECG, EMG, video CNN and projector) used as building blocks of the multimodal models.

layers.name: Legacy EEG Encoder Zoo
layers.description: 30+ third-party / pretrained EEG encoder implementations (CBraMod, LaBraM, EEGNet, ViT/DenseNet hybrids, RNN/TCN/CNN variants, DINO) plus task-specific registries that expose them by name.

layers.name: Fusion & Task Models
layers.description: Multimodal late-fusion and cross-attention modules, classification/localization heads, and the top-level binary and 5-class seizure subtype models that compose backbones, fusion blocks, and heads end-to-end.

layers.name: Loss Functions
layers.description: Focal loss, classification/localization losses, and the loss builder factory that selects and configures loss objectives for the binary and multi-class seizure detection tasks.

layers.name: Training & Evaluation Runtime
layers.description: The Trainer, Evaluator, and Inference engines that own the train/val/test loops, optimizer/scheduler stepping, checkpointing, and metric aggregation invoked by every CLI entry point.

layers.name: Shared Utilities
layers.description: Foundational, high fan-in helpers for config parsing, logging, IO, deterministic seeding, visualization, and binary/multiclass metric computation reused by every other code layer.

layers.name: CLI Entry Points
layers.description: Top fan-out command-line entry points (train, eval, infer, extract_features, prepare_dataset, task3 variants) that wire configs, datasets, models, and trainers into runnable jobs.

layers.name: Operational Scripts
layers.description: Shell wrappers (train.sh, eval.sh, prepare_dataset.sh, extract_features.sh, run_baseline_batch.sh) and Python aggregators that batch-launch CLI tools and roll up multi-run baseline results.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start here. The README introduces the NeuroMM-2026 challenge and frames the three tasks the codebase has to support: binary EEG-only spike detection (Task 1), binary EEG+Video late fusion (Task 2), and 5-class seizure subtype classification on positives only (Task 3). It also enumerates what ships in the repo (30+ EEG encoders, 7 video backbones, late-fusion models, per-seed aggregators), so by the end of this step you should know what every later step is in service of. The companion docs map the dataset layout and the canonical directory tree the loaders expect at runtime.

tour.title: Configuration Philosophy
tour.description: Every CLI in this repo runs off a YAML config that extends `configs/default.yaml` via a `default_config` key, so reading default.yaml is reading the master schema: seed, paths, runtime, model (EEG ResNet18 backbone), dataset shape `[26, 2000]`, and train/eval hyperparameters. `train_eeg_only.yaml` is the canonical Task 1 override and the file `scripts/run_baseline_batch.sh` sweeps across 30+ EEG encoders. The `.env.example` documents the eight `NEUROMM_*` environment variables that override paths at runtime so configs stay portable across machines.
tour.languageLesson: YAML config inheritance via a `default_config` key is a lightweight alternative to Hydra/OmegaConf: a tiny custom loader (see `utils/config.py` in Step 5) deep-merges child over parent, which keeps each task config to ~5 lines of overrides instead of duplicating 80 lines of defaults.

tour.title: Task 1 Entry Point
tour.description: `tools/train.py` is the canonical first entry point for users and the highest-fan-out file in the project (it pulls in eight downstream modules). It parses CLI args, applies `--model-name`/`--seed` overrides on top of the YAML config, sets seeds, builds dataset/model/criterion via runtime helpers, and hands off to `Trainer.fit` with checkpointing. `tools/main.py` sits one level above as a unified `train`/`eval`/`infer` dispatcher that simply forwards argv unchanged. Read these two together to see how a `python -m neuromm26_baseline.tools.train --config configs/train_eeg_only.yaml --model-name tcnet --seed 0` invocation flows.

tour.title: Shared Runtime Helpers
tour.description: `tools/runtime.py` is where the entry-point boilerplate is centralized: `build_dataset`, `build_model`, `build_dataloader`, and `build_criterion` are the four factories every Task 1/Task 2 trainer calls. By isolating these here, train.py, eval.py, and infer.py from Step 3 stay short and consistent — and swapping a dataset or model is a one-line config change rather than an entry-point edit. Task 3 has its own parallel runtime (`_task3_runtime.py`, covered in Step 11) because the positives-only filtering and 5-class remap diverge from the binary path.

tour.title: Foundational Utilities
tour.description: Five tiny modules with the highest fan-in in the project — every trainer, evaluator, and tool depends on them. `utils/config.py` implements the `default_config`-aware YAML loader from Step 2; `utils/seed.py` sets Python/NumPy/PyTorch RNG state for the per-seed reproducibility the leaderboard demands; `utils/logger.py` writes the per-epoch JSONL summary that the aggregators in Step 13 consume; `utils/io.py` resolves `NEUROMM_*` env vars from Step 2 to absolute paths; `utils/metrics.py` computes binary AUPRC (Task 1/2's selection metric).
tour.languageLesson: PyTorch deterministic seeding requires more than `torch.manual_seed`: you must also seed NumPy, Python's `random`, set `torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True`, and seed each DataLoader worker via `worker_init_fn`. `utils/seed.py` is the canonical place to see all five steps together.

tour.title: Binary Data Pipeline
tour.description: The Dataset layer turns the manifest CSV into PyTorch batches. `base_dataset.py` defines the abstract `__len__`/`__getitem__` contract; `eeg_feature_dataset.py` is the workhorse for Task 1 — it loads pre-computed EEG `.npy` waves from a manifest row, normalizes per-sample, and pads/crops to the fixed `[26, 2000]` shape from the default config. `multimodal_feature_dataset.py` wraps it for Task 2 by additionally loading per-sample video features. `collate_fn.py` is the custom `neuromm_collate` that stacks tensor fields and forwards non-tensor metadata (sample_id, subject_id) as Python lists — needed because default `default_collate` chokes on string fields.

tour.title: Manifest & Patient-Disjoint Splits
tour.description: The Datasets from Step 6 don't enumerate samples themselves — they read the 25,426-row manifest CSV. Each row carries `sample_id`, `split`, `label`, `label_type` (the 1-5 subtype used in Task 3), `subject_id`, plus `eeg_source_relpath` and `raw_video_relpath` that the Step 6 loaders resolve against the `NEUROMM_*` roots from Step 2. The split is patient-disjoint, which is non-negotiable for clinical EEG: two windows from the same subject must never straddle train and val. The dataset README points to the gated HuggingFace download.

tour.title: Trainer & Evaluator Loops
tour.description: `trainers/trainer.py` owns the train loop invoked by `Trainer.fit` from Step 3: forward pass, loss, backward, optimizer/scheduler step, per-epoch validation via the Evaluator, best-checkpoint selection by AUPRC (or weighted-F1 for Task 3), and JSONL logging through Step 5's logger. `trainers/evaluator.py` runs val/test passes without gradients and computes the metrics from Step 5's `metrics.py`. Together they are the engine that every CLI entry point — Task 1, 2, and 3 — ultimately dispatches to.

tour.title: Legacy EEG Encoder Zoo
tour.description: The selling point of this baseline is the 30+ pluggable EEG encoders, and `models/legacy/registry.py` is how they all become addressable by `--model-name` from Step 3. The registry maps a string name to a constructor, so `--model-name tcnet` resolves to `TCNet` from `tcnet.py` and `--model-name eegnet` resolves to `EEGNet` from `eegnet.py`. TCNet (a temporal-convolutional network) and EEGNet (the canonical depthwise-separable conv baseline for EEG) are representative; the registry also wires CBraMod, LaBraM, EEG-DINO, ViT/DenseNet hybrids, and RNN/LSTM/GRU variants. Adding a new encoder is a one-line registry entry plus the module file.
tour.languageLesson: Python's decorator-based registry pattern (`@register_model('tcnet')` populating a module-level dict) is the standard way to build plugin systems in PyTorch — see `timm`, `torchvision`, and HuggingFace `transformers`. The trade-off vs. an `if/elif` factory is that the encoder modules must be imported (typically from `legacy/__init__.py`) for their decorators to fire — otherwise the registry stays empty.

tour.title: Task 2: Multimodal Late Fusion
tour.description: Task 2 adds video. `tools/train_eeg_video_fusion.py` is the binary EEG+Video trainer, structurally a sibling of Step 3's train.py but with `require_video_feature=True` and a different model factory. `models/multimodal_late_fusion.py` is the top-level `nn.Module` that composes a Step 9 EEG encoder, a video projector backbone, a fusion module, and a binary head. Three fusion strategies live side-by-side in `models/fusion/`: `concat_fusion.py` (cheapest, just channel-cat then MLP), `cross_attention_fusion.py` (one modality's tokens attend to the other's), and `temporal_fusion.py` (preserves the time axis through fusion).

tour.title: Video Feature Extraction
tour.description: The Step 6 multimodal dataset loads pre-computed video features rather than raw frames, which is what makes 25k-sample training tractable on commodity GPUs. `feature_extract/extract_video_features.py` is a polymorphic extractor that drives 7 different vision backbones (CLIP, VideoMAE-base/large, DINOv2-base/large, SigLIP, TimeSformer) through one config-selected code path, writes embeddings to `processed/features/video/{feature_name}/` per the layout from Step 1's `project_structure.md`, and is invoked once offline so training only ever does cheap `.npy` loads. The `feature_extract.yaml` config switches `mode=feature_extract` to engage this tool.

tour.title: Task 3: 5-Class Seizure Subtype
tour.description: Task 3 diverges from Tasks 1-2 enough to deserve its own runtime. `datasets/task3_datasets.py` filters the manifest from Step 7 to positives only and remaps `label_type` 1..5 to class indices 0..4 for `CrossEntropyLoss`. `tools/_task3_runtime.py` is the parallel of Step 4's runtime.py with these subtype-aware factories. `tools/train_task3_eeg.py` is the EEG-only Task 3 trainer; `models/multiclass_late_fusion.py` is the EEG+Video subtype model. `utils/multiclass_metrics.py` provides weighted F1, the Task 3 selection metric — different from binary AUPRC because subtype frequencies are imbalanced and the leaderboard wants per-class fairness.

tour.title: Multi-Seed Aggregation
tour.description: Reporting a single seed on a clinical benchmark is statistically dishonest, so the workflow runs 4 seeds per model and reports mean ± std. `scripts/aggregate_results.py` walks `neuromm26_results/` collecting the per-epoch JSONL summaries Step 5's logger produced, picks the best epoch per run, and emits a per-model mean/std table for the binary tasks. `scripts/aggregate_task3_results.py` does the same for the weighted-F1 leaderboard from Step 12. The human-readable output of these scripts is exactly the format you see in `baseline_results.md`.

tour.title: Operational Sweep Wrapper
tour.description: The capstone: `scripts/run_baseline_batch.sh` is the operational shell wrapper that ties everything together. It takes a list of EEG model names, sweeps each across 4 seeds in parallel on 4 GPUs (one process per `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`), writes per-run logs, tracks failures, and at the end suggests `scripts/aggregate_results.py` from Step 13 to roll up the runs. This is how you reproduce a row of Step 13's results table end-to-end: pick a model, run this script, then aggregate. Reading it gives you a concrete picture of how the pieces from every prior step compose into a real experiment campaign.
tour.languageLesson: Bash GPU sweeping with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$((i % 4)) python ... &` plus `wait` for batch synchronization is the simplest possible job scheduler — no Slurm, no Ray, no Hydra multirun. It scales fine to a single 4-GPU box and degrades gracefully (just set `i % 1`). The pattern to copy: `&` to background, capture `$!` as PID, append to a PIDS array, then `wait "${PIDS[@]}"` for a barrier.
